source_integrity.primary_source_or_tradition: Chinese Hou Yi and ten suns myth, multiple traditional variants
source_integrity.narration_style: Clearly distinguish myth/legend from established history; do not present illustrative details as verified facts
source_integrity.translation_policy: New original paraphrase only; do not quote protected translations

image_reference.style_board_prompt: Create one horizontal 3:1 cohesive six-beat visual development frieze for Hou Yi: The Archer Who Shot the Suns in Han dynasty stone-rubbing motifs and silk painting, vermilion ink, lacquer-black outlines. Depict beginning, conflict, irreversible consequence, and ending. Same protagonist model across all panels. Distinct epoch-appropriate clothes and artifacts. Clear blank safe zones for vertical crops. Avoid fonts, literal writing, watermarks.
image_reference.art_style: Han dynasty stone-rubbing motifs and silk painting, vermilion ink, lacquer-black outlines
image_reference.palette: derive from the specified art style, not the preceding episode
image_reference.material_consistency: all individual scene panels must look as though carved, painted, embroidered or printed on the same physical medium

audio.narrator: one expressive documentary storyteller, natural cadence
audio.soundtrack_direction: guqin pulses, bamboo flute, thunder drum, string glissandi

music_licensing.source_files: locate and verify current track licenses before download; avoid unlicensed music
music_licensing.track_titles: unassigned; search within vetted libraries at production time

workflow.adapter_required: read caption fields directly; do not rely on separate audio/Sxx.txt files
steps: validate story JSON and factual claims
generate panels P01–P06 with consistent characters
generate narration sentence by sentence from caption
compose one timeline.json from measured narration and explicit pauses
word-align captions to speech, no overlaps
render camera moves from the same timeline
build licensed soundtrack and SFX from same timeline
run audio-visual QA and deliver MP4, SRT, manifest
workflow.narration_source: scenes[].caption; do not use any old cached Sxx.txt narration; opening_hook is metadata only
workflow.timing_adjustment: Render timings must be recomputed from new scene narration; existing audio, SRT and timeline are invalidated by script changes.
workflow.visual_progression_qa_gate: Every scene must reveal its ordered first/middle/final narrative anchors through a single smooth camera journey. Verify an actual new narrated event or visual fact appears at each anchor; moving or zooming over one unchanged picture is not sufficient. Reject hard crop jumps, arbitrary timed reframes and static single-tableau scenes; do not change narration or force scene duration.
workflow.visual_render_contract: Build one continuous horizontal story panorama per scene with three distinct subplots and semantic camera anchors. Use an alpha fade-in of the next scene over the outgoing image at scene boundaries; do not fade to black.
workflow.caption_render_contract: Export synchronized .srt and optional embedded selectable MP4 soft-subtitle track (mov_text); NO hardcoded/burn-in subtitle overlays or text on artwork.

scenes.caption: What if ten suns rose at once and scorched the earth? Chinese legend says they abandoned their usual turns.
required_visuals: ten vermilion sun disks above cracked farmland
Ordered opening visual discovery: One sun disk in its normal cycle
Ordered middle visual discovery: A second and third sun join the sky
Ordered ending visual discovery: Pull back to reveal all ten suns over cracking farmland
scenes.image_prompt: Wide contiguous horizontal left-to-right sequential story frieze for a travelling vertical 9:16 camera, with coherent Han dynasty stone-rubbing motifs and silk painting, vermilion ink, lacquer-black outlines. Scene: ten vermilion sun disks above cracked farmland. The source story is Hou Yi: The Archer Who Shot the Suns. Reuse exact character designs and border motifs from references/style_board.png; narrative relief/illustration, no modern objects, no printed captions or illegible text, no photorealistic cinematic actors. Additional narrative context for THIS scene: What if ten suns rose at once and scorched the earth? Once, according to a Chinese legend, ten suns rose together instead of taking turns. Depict this scene timing, but avoid literal words or text. ONE SCENE, THREE CONTIGUOUS LEFT-TO-RIGHT SUBPLOTS: LEFT—One sun disk in its normal cycle. MIDDLE—A second and third sun join the sky. RIGHT—Pull back to reveal all ten suns over cracking farmland. Depict these as distinct chronological visual facts from the existing narration, not three zooms of the same tableau. Create one physically coherent continuous illustrated environment and shared materials across boundaries, not separate stacked pictures or a three-card collage. Keep each important narrated subject big enough for its own vertical 9:16 crop, including adequate safe margins for optional player-drawn subtitles. Generate enough horizontal width and genuine detail for all three focal camera positions, using seamless high-resolution tiles if necessary. A continuous camera follows the artwork smoothly from left to right; do not expose the entire triptych at the start, pan across irrelevant empty terrain, or introduce hard crop jumps. Between DIFFERENT scenes use a normal alpha fade-in of the next scene over the outgoing scene—not a black flash. NO captions, text, watermarks, or subtitles burned into the generated illustration. Do not introduce facts absent from the existing narration.

camera.description: ONE UNBROKEN LEFT-TO-RIGHT STORY PASS: open on One sun disk in its normal cycle; glide over continuously joined artwork to reveal A second and third sun join the sky; arrive on Pull back to reveal all ten suns over cracking farmland. Use subject-anchored 9:16 portrait framing and narration-semantic timing. Rightward travel is the default; only minor vertical corrections or story-motivated zoom are allowed. No black flash, snap crop, or timer-driven reframe. Between scenes, use the episode-level alpha fade-in transition.

visual_layout.seams: Connect visual regions by contiguous landscape, architecture, ornament, or physical medium. Do not stack panels vertically or make a disconnected collage.
visual_layout.rendering_strategy: Generate enough native-resolution panorama tiles for three distinct portrait crops; assemble them seamlessly. Do not stretch one small portrait image across the frieze.

camera.camera_anchor_method: Derive left/middle/right anchors from actual generated subjects and readable 9:16 crops, not blindly from fixed fractional coordinates
camera.timing_method: Align each anchor arrival to the relevant spoken narration clause using actual waveform or word alignment; do not divide time equally by subplot
camera.frame_validation: Confirm all required subjects are readable on a phone and all three subplots reveal different narrated information
